# Create basic modules and work space.
env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.50
mkdir m1_22_0
bolero mod init -C m1_22_0
bolero mod edit -C m1_22_0 -go=1.22.0 -toolchain=go1.99.0
mkdir m1_22_1
bolero mod init -C m1_22_1
bolero mod edit -C m1_22_1 -go=1.22.1 -toolchain=go1.99.1
mkdir m1_24_rc0
bolero mod init -C m1_24_rc0
bolero mod edit -C m1_24_rc0 -go=1.24rc0 -toolchain=go1.99.2

bolero work init
grep '^go 1.50$' go.work
! grep toolchain go.work

# work use with older modules should leave go 1.50 in the go.work.
bolero work use ./m1_22_0
grep '^go 1.50$' go.work
! grep toolchain go.work

# work use with newer modules should bump go and toolchain,
# including updating to a newer toolchain as needed.
env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.21
env TESTGO_VERSION_SWITCH=switch
rm go.work
bolero work init
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
! bolero work use ./m1_22_0
stderr '^bolero: m1_22_0'${/}'go.mod requires go >= 1.22.0 \(running go 1.21; BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local\)$'
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto
bolero work use ./m1_22_0
stderr '^bolero: m1_22_0'${/}'go.mod requires go >= 1.22.0; switching to go1.22.9$'
grep '^go 1.22.0$' go.work
! grep toolchain go.work

# work use with an even newer module should bump go again.
bolero work use ./m1_22_1
stderr '^bolero: m1_22_1'${/}'go.mod requires go >= 1.22.1; switching to go1.22.9$'
grep '^go 1.22.1$' go.work
! grep toolchain go.work

# work use with an even newer module should bump go and toolchain again.
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.22.9
! bolero work use ./m1_24_rc0
stderr '^bolero: m1_24_rc0'${/}'go.mod requires go >= 1.24rc0 \(running go 1.22.9; BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.22.9\)$'
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto
bolero work use ./m1_24_rc0
stderr '^bolero: m1_24_rc0'${/}'go.mod requires go >= 1.24rc0; switching to go1.24rc1$'
grep '^go 1.24rc0$' go.work
! grep 'toolchain' go.work
